children: SAINT HELIER, JE / ACCESS Newswire / October 16, 2026 /

Caledonia Mining Corporation Plc ("Caledonia" or "the Company") announces that it received notification on October 15, 2026 from BlackRock, Inc. that on October 14, 2026 it had crossed a threshold for notification of a relevant change (as defined by the AIM Rules for Companies).
